svg.title: Отжимания на узких брусьях с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Narrow parallel-bar assisted triceps dip. One hand on each of two recognizable fixed shoulder-width parallel bars, with both bars visible, true front-side oblique angle. One taut closed-loop elastic assist band spans BETWEEN both bars and slings UNDER the bent knees, supporting knee weight in both phases. START top arms almost straight, vertical torso, knees bent and feet suspended. FINISH body visibly lower, elbows bend backward about 90 degrees beside upright torso, shoulders remain above bar height. Hands stay at same points, same frame and feet never touch floor. Show clear continuous band segments from both bar attachments to underside of knees. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
